message.content:
## Root cause `app` in namespace `default` is a **bare Pod** (no controller owner — `kubectl get rs,deploy,sts,ds -n default` returned nothing). Its only container, `web`, ran `httpd -f -p 8080 -h /srv` with the `shared` emptyDir mounted at `/srv`, but nothing ever wrote there. Observed before the fix: - `GET /` → `wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found` - `ls -la /srv` → empty Pod container lists are immutable, so the smallest justified fix was to recreate the same Pod with one additional container writing into the existing `shared` emptyDir, preserving everything else. ## Change made Deleted and recreated only the `app` Pod manifest, keeping `labels{app:app}`, the `web` container's image/command/port, `restartPolicy: Always`, and the `shared` emptyDir mount, adding: - `page-writer` container (`busybox:1.37.0`) mounting the same `shared` volume at `/srv`, writing `index.html` and then staying alive with `while true; do sleep 3600; done` (so it does not enter a restart loop). ## Verified outcome (fresh observations) - Symptom gone: `GET /` on the Pod IP `10.244.0.6:8080` from a **separate client Pod** returned: - `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`, `Content-type: text/html`, `Content-Length: 131`, body `

Hello from the shared volume sidecar!

` - Same result from inside the `web` container (`GET / -> OK`); `/srv` now contains `index.html` (131 bytes). - Pod state: `app 2/2 Running`, `phase=Running`. - Container statuses: `page-writer(... ready=true, restarts=0)`, `web(... ready=true, restarts=0)`. - Shared state confirmed: `mounts=web->shared page-writer->shared`; volume `shared` is still an `emptyDir`. - Original web config intact: `webCmd=["sh","-c","httpd -f -p 8080 -h /srv"]`, `containerPort=8080` (name `http`). - No warning events for `app`; the transient verification Pod `http-check` was deleted.
